# BALLKNW - LLM Access File

**Site Name:** BALLKNW

**URL:** https://ballknw.com

**Purpose:** Free, no-login web-based football quiz and simulation games designed to test and grow football knowledge through daily puzzles and strategic team management.

## Games

### Daily Scout
- **Type:** Daily word-puzzle variant (Wordle-style)
- **Gameplay:** Guess a mystery World Cup player in 6 attempts
- **Clues:** Nation, position, era, rating, and pace revealed after each guess
- **Features:** Daily streaks, shareable emoji result grids
- **URL:** https://ballknw.com/scout/

### Name Your Side (8-0-0)
- **Type:** Squad draft and tournament simulation
- **Gameplay:** Draft 11 players (one per squad) from randomly selected real World Cup squads (1930–2026), then guide them through a tournament
- **Features:** Formation selection, full XI drafting, tactical decisions, tournament play
- **URL:** https://ballknw.com/perfect-cup/

### Football Manager
- **Type:** Club management simulation
- **Gameplay:** Take charge of a club, select formation and XI, trade on the transfer market, manage a full 38-round season
- **Features:** League navigation, promotion/relegation, tactical management
- **URL:** https://ballknw.com/football-manager/

## Key Features

- **No Login Required:** Play instantly without accounts or sign-ups
- **Privacy-First:** All game progress stored locally in browser; no personal data collection
- **Gameplay-Oriented Data:** Player ratings and squads styled for gameplay and sourced from historical World Cup records (1930–2026)
- **Cross-Platform:** Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers
- **Shareable Results:** Emoji grid sharing for Scout puzzle results
- **Historical Scope:** 192 country squads with stylized player rating approximations

## Data & Attribution

- Player and squad data sourced from public football datasets
- Fjelstul World Cup Database (CC-BY-SA 4.0) used for historical squad information
- Player ratings are styled approximations built for gameplay, not official statistics
- Site is unofficial and not affiliated with FIFA, Premier League, Sports Interactive, SEGA, EA Sports, or any federation/club

## Core Sections

- **Home:** Game overview, featured puzzles, trust metrics
- **Privacy Policy:** Consent, analytics, advertising, data practices

- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (TypeScript in sub-apps)
- Architecture: Static site with embedded game applications
- Hosting: GitHub Pages / Netlify
- Analytics: PostHog (optional, consent-based)
- Ads: Google AdSense (optional, consent-based)
